mapper.select: SELECT stock_id, name FROM stocks ORDER BY stock_id
SELECT stock_id AS stockId, name, content, publication_balance AS publicationBalance, publication_price AS publicationPrice, prev_price AS prevPrice FROM stocks ORDER BY stock_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stocks (name, content, publication_price, publication_balance, prev_price) VALUES (#{name}, #{content}, #{publicationPrice}, #{publicationBalance}, #{publicationPrice})
